file_write.scope: Only scripts/run_short_dna_alignment.py may read the caller's explicit local FASTA, FASTQ, and minimap2 paths after resolving and pinning final regular targets; create private temporary copies and alignment artifacts; and create the caller-specified new SAM and JSON leaf files in the current working directory. It may not replace an output, publish outside the working directory, mutate an input, create user directories, or use the network.
file_write.reason: Private staging isolates the fixed adapter, and create-exclusive atomic publication prevents overwriting either requested artifact.

target_enforcement.openai: Allow only private temporary work plus the explicit new SAM and JSON leaf files in the working directory; remote inline execution is forbidden.
target_enforcement.claude: Allow only private temporary work plus the explicit new SAM and JSON leaf files in the working directory; remote inline execution is forbidden.
target_enforcement.generic: Run locally and allow only private staging plus the two caller-approved create-new outputs.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust plus explicit write approval is required for the two create-new outputs.

local_subprocess.scope: scripts/run_short_dna_alignment.py may resolve an explicit local minimap2 path, including an ordinary symlink, to a stable executable regular target; compute and record its SHA-256; optionally require a caller-supplied expected SHA-256; require exact minimap2 2.31-r1302; and use a fixed short-genomic-DNA argv, one thread, fixed seed, private cwd, clean environment, no stdin, no shell, no caller flags, no installation, and no fallback aligner.
local_subprocess.reason: Stable target pinning, automatic fingerprinting, optional expected-digest replay, exact version checking, and a fixed argv make minimap2 the sole bounded adapter and preserve fail-closed execution without forcing callers to precompute a digest.

target_enforcement.openai: Permit only the resolved, fingerprinted fixed minimap2 invocation; enforce an expected digest when supplied and reject shell expansion, caller flags, alternate tools, and version drift.
target_enforcement.claude: Permit only the resolved, fingerprinted fixed minimap2 invocation; enforce an expected digest when supplied and reject shell expansion, caller flags, alternate tools, and version drift.
target_enforcement.generic: Execute only the fixed adapter after stable input and executable binding, automatic fingerprinting, any supplied expected-digest check, and exact version validation.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust plus explicit local-process approval is required for the fixed minimap2 invocation.
